```{r, fig.width = 30, fig.height = 60, fig.cap="Networks or undirected simple graphs produced by Heinz (Dittrich et al. 2008), HotNet2 (Leiserson et al. 2015), SigMod (Liu et al. 2017), dmGWAS (Wang et al. 2015), LEAN (Gwinner et al. 2017), MAGMABH which corresponds to MAGMA output (de Leeuw et al. 2015) after Benjamini-Hochberg correction, cGWAS (classical GWAS) which corresponds to mapping significant SNPs to the corresponding gene, MAGMABH+cGWAS which corresponds to joining both genes from MAGMABH and cGWAS. Heinz selected 693 genes; HotNet2 selected 454 genes; SigMod selected 204 genes; dmGWAS selected 147 genes; LEAN selected 22 genes; MAGMABH selected 432 genes; cGWAS selected 240 genes; MAGMABH+cGWAS selected 448 genes"}
library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(magrittr)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
suppressMessages(library(network))
suppressMessages(library(sna))
library(ggnetwork)
library(scatterpie)
library(ggnewscale)

# Transparent ggplot theme (no panel, plot or legend background, no grid lines), so the figures can be placed on any background.
theme_transparent <- theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"), # bg of the panel
                           plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA), # bg of the plot
                           panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # get rid of major grid
                           panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # get rid of minor grid
                           legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA), # get rid of legend bg
                           legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA) # get rid of legend panel bg
)

theme_set(theme_cowplot() + theme_transparent)

ppi <- read_tsv('data/biogrid_mv_physical_4.4.249_tab2_onlyhuman_9606_interactorsAB.tsv', col_types = 'cc') %>%
  select(`Official Symbol Interactor A`, `Official Symbol Interactor B`) %>%
  graph_from_data_frame(directed = FALSE) %>%
  as_tbl_graph

methods <- c('Heinz','HotNet2', 'SigMod', 'cGWAS', 'MAGMABH', 'dmGWAS', 'LEAN', 'MAGMABHcGWAS')

method_palette <- c('Heinz' = '#73471f',
                    'HotNet2' = '#377eb8', 'SigMod' = '#f4888a', 'All' = 'gray50',
                    'Consensus' = 'black', 'MAGMABH' = '#abdda4', 'cGWAS' = '#fdae61', 'dmGWAS' = '#80cdc1', 'LEAN' = '#4d9221')

genesrc_palette <- c('MAGMABH' = '#abdda4', 'cGWAS' = '#fdae61', 'MAGMABH and cGWAS' = '#d3c783', 'Methods only' = '#ffffff')

plot_network <- function(net, selected_nodes) {
  
  graph <- activate(net, nodes) %>%
    filter(name %in% selected_nodes)
  class(graph) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')
  
  ggnetwork(graph) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
    geom_edges(color = '#3282b8') +
    geom_nodes(color = '#233142', size = 4) +
    #geom_label(aes(label = name),
    #                 size = 2) +
    ggtitle(' ') +
    theme_blank() + theme_transparent + 
    theme(title = element_text(hjust = 1, face = 'bold'))
}

# heinz
heinz <- read_tsv('data/heinz/selected_genes_split_1.heinz.txt', col_types = 'c')$gene
heinz_plt <- plot_network(ppi, heinz) 
heinz_plt_square <- heinz_plt + coord_fixed(ratio = 1) # Add coord_fixed(ratio = 1) to make the plot square

# hotnet2
hotnet2 <- read_tsv('data/hotnet2/selected_genes_split_1.hotnet2.tsv', col_types = 'cc')$gene
hotnet2_plt <- plot_network(ppi, hotnet2)
hotnet2_plt_square <- hotnet2_plt + coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

# sigmod
sigmod <- read_tsv('data/sigmod/selected_genes_split_1.sigmod.txt', col_types = 'c')$gene
sigmod_plt <- plot_network(ppi, sigmod)
sigmod_plt_square <- sigmod_plt + coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

# dmgwas
dmgwas <- read_tsv('data/dmgwas/selected_genes_split_1.dmgwas.txt', col_types = 'c')$gene
dmgwas_plt <- plot_network(ppi, dmgwas)
dmgwas_plt_square <- dmgwas_plt + coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

# lean
lean <- read_tsv('data/lean/selected_genes_split_1.lean.txt', col_types = 'c')$gene
lean_plt <- plot_network(ppi, lean)
lean_plt_square <- lean_plt + coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

# Classical GWAS
cgwas_genes <- read_tsv('data/pso.genes.annot_gene_ids_names.tsv', col_types = 'c')$Gene %>% unique()
cgwas_plt <- plot_network(ppi, cgwas_genes)
cgwas_plt_square <- plot_network(ppi, cgwas_genes) + coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

# Magma output after Benjamini Hochberg correction
magmabh <- read_tsv('data/pso.scores.genes.out_converted_pruned_bhcorrection.tsv', 
                    col_types = 'iiciiiiiidnn')$Gene %>% unique()
magmabh_plt <- plot_network(ppi, magmabh)
magmabh_plt_square <- plot_network(ppi, magmabh) + coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

# Magma output together with classical gwas annotation output
magmabh_cgwas <- union(magmabh, cgwas_genes)
magmabh_cgwas_plt <- plot_network(ppi, magmabh_cgwas)
magmabh_cgwas_plt_square <- plot_network(ppi, magmabh_cgwas) + coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

# Magma output intersected with classical gwas annotation output
magmabh_and_cgwas <- intersect(magmabh, cgwas_genes)
magmabh_and_cgwas_plt <- plot_network(ppi, magmabh_and_cgwas)
magmabh_and_cgwas_plt_square <- plot_network(ppi, magmabh_and_cgwas) + coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

topology_panel <- plot_grid(heinz_plt, hotnet2_plt, sigmod_plt, dmgwas_plt, lean_plt, magmabh_plt, cgwas_plt, magmabh_cgwas_plt,
                            labels = c('\nHeinz','\nHotNet2','\nSigMod', 'dmGWAS', 'LEAN', 'MAGMABH', '\ncGWAS', 'MAGMABH+cGWAS'),
                            label_size = 30,
                            nrow = 4,
                            ncol = 2)

topology_panel
```


```{r, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 10, fig.cap="Stable consensus network comprising 258 genes built by choosing those genes selected in at least 7 out of 25 solutions. This network highlights genes in common with known gene lists from Ran et al. (2019, Tsoi et al. (2017), Dand et al. (2025) and Zhang et al. (2025)."}
ran_psoriasis_genes <- read_tsv('data/gene_lists/ran_psoriasis_genes.tsv',
                                col_types = 'cc') %>%
  select(gene) %>%
  mutate(gene = toupper(gene))

tsoi_psoriasis_genes <- read_csv('data/gene_lists/tsoi_psoriasis_genes.csv',
                                 col_types = 'cc') %>%
  select(`Closest Gene`)%>%
  mutate(`Closest Gene` = toupper(`Closest Gene`))

dand_psoriasis_genes <- read_csv('data/gene_lists/dand_psoriasis_closest_protein_genes.tsv',
                                 col_types = 'c') %>%
  select(gene) %>%
  mutate(gene = toupper(gene))

zhang_psoriasis_genes <- read_csv('data/gene_lists/zhang_psoriasis_genes.tsv',
                                  col_types = 'c') %>%
  select(gene) %>%
  mutate(gene = toupper(gene))

gen_list <- c('Ran2019', 'Tsoi2017', 'Dand2025', 'Zhang2025')
gen_list_palette <- c('Ran2019' = '#bebada', 'Tsoi2017' = '#80b1d3', 'Dand2025' = '#b3de69', 'Zhang2025' = '#fccde5')

# compilation of genes selected by all the methods across the different datasets.
heinz_genes <- c()
hotnet2_genes <- c()
sigmod_genes <- c()
dmgwas_genes <- c()
lean_genes <- c()

nsplits <- 5 # Number of splits applied to the data.
nmethods <- 5 # Number of biological network methods used

for (j in 1:nsplits) {
  # Read genes selected by Heinz
  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/", "data_split_", j, "/heinz/selected_genes_split_", j, ".heinz.txt")
  heinz_genes <- unique(c(heinz_genes, read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'c')$gene))
  
  # Read genes selected by HotNet2
  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/", "data_split_", j, "/hotnet2/selected_genes_split_", j, ".hotnet2.tsv")
  hotnet2_genes <- unique(c(hotnet2_genes, read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'cc')$gene))
  
  # Read genes selected by SigMod
  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/", "data_split_", j, "/sigmod/selected_genes_split_", j, ".sigmod.txt")
  sigmod_genes <- unique(c(sigmod_genes, read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'c')$gene))
  
  # Read genes selected by DMGWAS
  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/", "data_split_", j, "/dmgwas/selected_genes_split_", j, ".dmgwas.txt")
  dmgwas_genes <- unique(c(dmgwas_genes, read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'c')$gene))
  
  # Read genes selected by Lean
  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/", "data_split_", j, "/lean/selected_genes_split_", j, ".lean.txt")
  lean_genes <- unique(c(lean_genes, read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'c')$gene))
}


# powersets
gene_lists_subsets <- c()
gene_lists_src <- list()

for (j in 1:nsplits) {
  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/","data_split_", j, "/heinz/selected_genes_split_", j, ".heinz.txt")
  gene_lists_src[[length(gene_lists_src) + 1]] <- read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'c')$gene

  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/","data_split_", j, "/hotnet2/selected_genes_split_", j, ".hotnet2.tsv")
  gene_lists_src[[length(gene_lists_src) + 1]] <- read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'cc')$gene

  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/","data_split_", j, "/sigmod/selected_genes_split_", j, ".sigmod.txt")
  gene_lists_src[[length(gene_lists_src) + 1]] <- read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'c')$gene
  
  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/","data_split_", j, "/dmgwas/selected_genes_split_", j, ".dmgwas.txt")
  gene_lists_src[[length(gene_lists_src) + 1]] <- read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'c')$gene

  file_name <- paste0("data/stable_consensus/data_splits/","data_split_", j, "/lean/selected_genes_split_", j, ".lean.txt")
  gene_lists_src[[length(gene_lists_src) + 1]] <- read_tsv(file_name, col_types = 'c')$gene
}

for (gene_list in gene_lists_src) {
  for (gene in gene_list) {
    if (gene %in% names(gene_lists_subsets)) {
      gene_lists_subsets[gene] <- gene_lists_subsets[gene] + 1
    } else {
      gene_lists_subsets[gene] <- 1
    }
  }
}

# Calculate the number of genes appearing in at least 1, 2, 3, ..., nmethods * nsplits lists
max_occurrences <- nmethods * nsplits

# Loop through the process n times
for (i in seq(1, max_occurrences)) {
  # Genes in at least i solutions
  gene_set <- names(gene_lists_subsets[gene_lists_subsets >= i])
}

# Genes in at least 7 solutions

class(g_magmabh_and_cgwas) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

                Dand2025 =  as.numeric(name %in% dand_psoriasis_genes$gene),

                ) %>%
  filter(xend == x & yend == y) %>%
  select(x, y, name, all_of(gen_list)
         ) %>%

edges <- filter(gset7, xend != x | yend != y)

common_ran_psoriasis_genes <- nodes$name %in% ran_psoriasis_genes$gene
common_tsoi_psoriasis_genes <- nodes$name %in% tsoi_psoriasis_genes$`Closest Gene`
common_dand_psoriasis_genes <- nodes$name %in% dand_psoriasis_genes$gene
common_zhang_psoriasis_genes <- nodes$name %in% zhang_psoriasis_genes$gene
common_all_gen_lists <- common_ran_psoriasis_genes | common_tsoi_psoriasis_genes | common_dand_psoriasis_genes | common_zhang_psoriasis_genes

consensus_pie_gene_lists <- ggplot() +
  geom_edges(data = edges, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
             color = '#393e46', linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = filter(nodes, !common_all_gen_lists),
             aes(x = x, y = y),
             size = 1, color = '#393e46') +
  geom_scatterpie(data = nodes, aes(x = x, y = y, r=0.011), cols = gen_list) +
  geom_label_repel(data = filter(nodes, common_all_gen_lists),
                   aes(x = x, y = y, label = name),
                   size = 6, point.padding = 1, max.time = 5, max.iter = 20000,
                   max.overlaps = 30) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_blank() +
  labs(fill = 'Gen list') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gen_list_palette) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(legend.position = 'left',
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20, vjust = .2),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 22, vjust = 1)) +
  theme_transparent

```{r, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 10, fig.cap="Stable consensus network built by choosing those genes selected in at least 7 out of 25 solutions. There are 258 genes in the network."}

gene_set7 <- names(gene_lists_subsets[gene_lists_subsets >= 7])
gene_set7_plt <- plot_network(ppi, gene_set7)

# Gene set 7

gset7 <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
  filter(name %in% gene_set7) %>%
  mutate(gset7 = TRUE)
class(gset7) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

consensus_gg <- function(gset, g_cgwas, g_magmabh, g_magmabh_and_cgwas, 
                         cgwas_genes, magmabh, magmabh_and_cgwas) {
  
  # gset <- gset %>% to_undirected
  
  gset <- gset %>% graph_join(g_magmabh_and_cgwas, by = c('name')) %>% 
    graph_join(g_cgwas, by = c('name')) %>%
    graph_join(g_magmabh, by = c('name')) %>%
    to_undirected %>%
    mutate(magmabh_and_cgwas = ifelse(is.na(magmabh_and_cgwas), FALSE, magmabh_and_cgwas),
           cgwas_genes = ifelse(is.na(cgwas_genes), FALSE, cgwas_genes),
           magmabh = ifelse(is.na(magmabh), FALSE, magmabh)) %>%
    filter(name %in% V(gset)$name)
  
  set.seed(42)   # fixes the network layout for reproductibility
  gset %>%
  ggnetwork %>%
  mutate(name = as.character(name))
}

consensus <- consensus_gg(gset7, g_cgwas, g_magmabh, g_magmabh_and_cgwas,
                          cgwas_genes, magmabh, magmabh_and_cgwas)

nodes <- mutate(consensus,
                Heinz = as.numeric(name %in% heinz_genes),
                HotNet2 = as.numeric(name %in% hotnet2_genes),
                SigMod = as.numeric(name %in% sigmod_genes),
                dmGWAS = as.numeric(name %in% dmgwas_genes),
                LEAN = as.numeric(name %in% lean_genes),
                cGWAS = as.numeric(cgwas_genes),
                MAGMABH = as.numeric(magmabh),
                MAGMABHcGWAS = as.numeric(magmabh_and_cgwas)
                ) %>%
  filter(xend == x & yend == y) %>%
  select(x, y, name, all_of(methods)) %>%
  unique

nodes <- nodes %>%
  mutate(label_group = case_when(
    MAGMABHcGWAS == 1 ~ 'MAGMABH and cGWAS',
    MAGMABH == 1 ~ 'MAGMABH',
    cGWAS == 1 ~ 'cGWAS',
    TRUE ~ 'Methods only')
  )

edges <- filter(consensus, xend != x | yend != y)

consensus_pie_methods <- ggplot() +
  geom_edges(data = edges, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
             color = '#393e46', linewidth = 1) +
  geom_scatterpie(data = nodes, aes(x = x, y = y, r=0.007), cols = setdiff(methods, c('MAGMABH', 'cGWAS', 'MAGMABHcGWAS'))) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Methods", values = method_palette) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_label_repel(data = nodes,
                   aes(x = x, y = y, label = name, fill = label_group),
                   size = 3, point.padding = 1, max.time = 5, max.iter = 20000,
                   max.overlaps = 100) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Gene source", values = genesrc_palette) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_blank() +
  guides(color = "none", fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes = aes(label = "  ")
  )) +
  theme(legend.position = 'left',
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20, vjust = .2),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 22, vjust = 1)) +
  theme_transparent

consensus_pie_methods
```

library(patchwork)


# cGWAS
g_cgwas <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
  filter(name %in% cgwas_genes) %>%
  mutate(cgwas_genes = TRUE)
class(g_cgwas) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

# MAGMA_BH
g_magmabh <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
  filter(name %in% magmabh) %>%
  mutate(magmabh = TRUE)
class(g_magmabh) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

# MAGMA_BH and cGWAS
g_magmabh_and_cgwas <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
  filter(name %in% magmabh_and_cgwas) %>%
  mutate(magmabh_and_cgwas = TRUE)
class(g_magmabh_and_cgwas) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

# Heinz
g_heinz <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
  filter(name %in% heinz) %>%
  mutate(heinz = TRUE)
class(g_heinz) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

# HotNet2
g_hotnet2 <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
  filter(name %in% hotnet2) %>%
  mutate(hotnet2 = TRUE)
class(g_hotnet2) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

# SigMod
g_sigmod <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
  filter(name %in% sigmod) %>%
  mutate(sigmod = TRUE)
class(g_sigmod) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

# dmGWAS
g_dmgwas <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
  filter(name %in% dmgwas) %>%
  mutate(dmgwas = TRUE)
class(g_dmgwas) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

# LEAN
g_lean <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
  filter(name %in% lean) %>%
  mutate(lean = TRUE)
class(g_lean) <- c('igraph','tbl_graph')

make_consensus_plot <- function(n) {

  consensus <- graph_join(g_heinz, g_hotnet2, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_sigmod, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_dmgwas, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_lean, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_magmabh_and_cgwas, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_cgwas, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_magmabh, by = 'name') %>%
    to_undirected %>%
    mutate(heinz = ifelse(is.na(heinz), FALSE, heinz),
           hotnet2 = ifelse(is.na(hotnet2), FALSE, hotnet2),
           sigmod = ifelse(is.na(sigmod), FALSE, sigmod),
           dmgwas = ifelse(is.na(dmgwas), FALSE, dmgwas),
           lean = ifelse(is.na(lean), FALSE, lean),
           magmabh_and_cgwas = ifelse(is.na(magmabh_and_cgwas), FALSE, magmabh_and_cgwas),
           cgwas_genes = ifelse(is.na(cgwas_genes), FALSE, cgwas_genes),
           magmabh = ifelse(is.na(magmabh), FALSE, magmabh),
           num_methods = rowSums(cbind(heinz, hotnet2, sigmod, dmgwas, lean))) %>%
    filter(num_methods >= n)

  set.seed(42)
  consensus_gg <- consensus %>%
    ggnetwork %>%
    mutate(name = as.character(name))

  nodes <- mutate(consensus_gg,
                  Heinz = as.numeric(name %in% heinz_genes),
                  HotNet2 = as.numeric(name %in% hotnet2_genes),
                  SigMod = as.numeric(name %in% sigmod_genes),
                  dmGWAS = as.numeric(name %in% dmgwas_genes),
                  LEAN = as.numeric(name %in% lean_genes),
                  cGWAS = as.numeric(cgwas_genes),
                  MAGMABH = as.numeric(magmabh),
                  MAGMABHcGWAS = as.numeric(magmabh_and_cgwas)) %>%
    filter(xend == x & yend == y) %>%
    select(x, y, name, all_of(methods)) %>%
    unique

  nodes <- nodes %>%
    mutate(label_group = case_when(
      MAGMABHcGWAS == 1 ~ 'MAGMABH and cGWAS',
      MAGMABH == 1 ~ 'MAGMABH',
      cGWAS == 1 ~ 'cGWAS',
      TRUE ~ 'Methods only'))

  edges <- filter(consensus_gg, xend != x | yend != y)

  ggplot() +
    geom_edges(data = edges, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               color = '#393e46', linewidth = 1) +
    geom_scatterpie(data = nodes, aes(x = x, y = y, r = 0.007),
                    cols = setdiff(methods, c('MAGMABH', 'cGWAS', 'MAGMABHcGWAS'))) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Methods", values = method_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_label_repel(data = nodes,
                     aes(x = x, y = y, label = name, fill = label_group),
                     size = 3, point.padding = 1, max.time = 5, max.iter = 20000,
                     max.overlaps = 100) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Gene source", values = genesrc_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_blank() +
    guides(color = "none", fill = guide_legend(override.aes = aes(label = "  "))) +
    theme(legend.position = 'left',
          legend.text = element_text(size = 20, vjust = .2),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 22, vjust = 1)) +
    theme_transparent +
    ggtitle(paste0("Consensus network: genes selected by >= ", n, " methods"))
}

# Build one plot per threshold
consensus_plots <- lapply(1:5, make_consensus_plot)

# Combine into one figure (2 columns x 3 rows)
wrap_plots(consensus_plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```{r, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 20, fig.cap="Robustness of the consensus network built by changing the biological prior knowledge network: High-quality INTeractomes (HINT) (a), Integrated Interactions Database (IID) (b), IntAct Molecular Interaction Database (c), and Search Tool for Recurring Instances of Neighbouring Genes (STRING) (d)."}

library(patchwork)

# Folder of each network and the path to its PPI file
networks <- list(
  HINT   = list(dir = 'data/hint/',
                ppi_file = 'data/hint/hint_homo_sapiens_lcb_hq_hgnc.tsv'),
  IID    = list(dir = 'data/iid/',
                ppi_file = 'data/iid/human_annotated_integrated_interactions_database_skin_not_sun_exposed_exp.tsv'),
  IntAct = list(dir = 'data/intact/',
                ppi_file = 'data/intact/intact_human_association_physical_direct_interaction_types_2026-04-14-10-00_hgnc.tsv'),
  STRING = list(dir = 'data/string/',
                ppi_file = 'data/string/9606.protein.links.v12.0.min900.onlyAB_hgnc.tsv')
)

# Read a PPI file with two gene columns and return a tbl_graph
read_ppi <- function(path) {
  read_tsv(path, col_types = cols(.default = 'c')) %>%
    select(`Official Symbol Interactor A`, `Official Symbol Interactor B`) %>%
    graph_from_data_frame(directed = FALSE) %>%
    as_tbl_graph
}

build_consensus_plot <- function(net_name, net, n = 3) {

  ppi <- read_ppi(net$ppi_file)
  d <- net$dir

  # Method outputs for this network
  heinz   <- read_tsv(file.path(d, 'heinz/selected_genes_split_1.heinz.txt'), col_types = 'c')$gene
  hotnet2 <- read_tsv(file.path(d, 'hotnet2/selected_genes_split_1.hotnet2.tsv'), col_types = 'cc')$gene
  sigmod  <- read_tsv(file.path(d, 'sigmod/selected_genes_split_1.sigmod.txt'), col_types = 'c')$gene
  dmgwas  <- read_tsv(file.path(d, 'dmgwas/selected_genes_split_1.dmgwas.txt'), col_types = 'c')$gene
  lean    <- read_tsv(file.path(d, 'lean/selected_genes_split_1.lean.txt'), col_types = 'c')$gene

  # Helper to create one subgraph per gene set
  make_sub <- function(genes, label) {
    g <- activate(ppi, nodes) %>%
      filter(name %in% genes) %>%
      mutate(!!label := TRUE)
    class(g) <- c('igraph', 'tbl_graph')
    g
  }

  g_cgwas             <- make_sub(cgwas_genes, 'cgwas_genes')
  g_magmabh           <- make_sub(magmabh, 'magmabh')
  g_magmabh_and_cgwas <- make_sub(magmabh_and_cgwas, 'magmabh_and_cgwas')
  g_heinz             <- make_sub(heinz, 'heinz')
  g_hotnet2           <- make_sub(hotnet2, 'hotnet2')
  g_sigmod            <- make_sub(sigmod, 'sigmod')
  g_dmgwas            <- make_sub(dmgwas, 'dmgwas')
  g_lean              <- make_sub(lean, 'lean')

  consensus <- graph_join(g_heinz, g_hotnet2, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_sigmod, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_dmgwas, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_lean, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_magmabh_and_cgwas, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_cgwas, by = 'name') %>%
    graph_join(g_magmabh, by = 'name') %>%
    to_undirected %>%
    mutate(heinz = ifelse(is.na(heinz), FALSE, heinz),
           hotnet2 = ifelse(is.na(hotnet2), FALSE, hotnet2),
           sigmod = ifelse(is.na(sigmod), FALSE, sigmod),
           dmgwas = ifelse(is.na(dmgwas), FALSE, dmgwas),
           lean = ifelse(is.na(lean), FALSE, lean),
           magmabh_and_cgwas = ifelse(is.na(magmabh_and_cgwas), FALSE, magmabh_and_cgwas),
           cgwas_genes = ifelse(is.na(cgwas_genes), FALSE, cgwas_genes),
           magmabh = ifelse(is.na(magmabh), FALSE, magmabh),
           num_methods = rowSums(cbind(heinz, hotnet2, sigmod, dmgwas, lean))) %>%
    filter(num_methods >= n)

  set.seed(42)
  consensus_gg <- consensus %>%
    ggnetwork %>%
    mutate(name = as.character(name))

  nodes <- mutate(consensus_gg,
                  Heinz = as.numeric(heinz),
                  HotNet2 = as.numeric(hotnet2),
                  SigMod = as.numeric(sigmod),
                  dmGWAS = as.numeric(dmgwas),
                  LEAN = as.numeric(lean),
                  cGWAS = as.numeric(cgwas_genes),
                  MAGMABH = as.numeric(magmabh),
                  MAGMABHcGWAS = as.numeric(magmabh_and_cgwas)) %>%
    filter(xend == x & yend == y) %>%
    select(x, y, name, all_of(methods)) %>%
    unique

  nodes <- nodes %>%
    mutate(label_group = case_when(
      MAGMABHcGWAS == 1 ~ 'MAGMABH and cGWAS',
      MAGMABH == 1 ~ 'MAGMABH',
      cGWAS == 1 ~ 'cGWAS',
      TRUE ~ 'Methods only'))

  edges <- filter(consensus_gg, xend != x | yend != y)


  # stop("DEBUG: nodes columns are: ", paste(names(nodes), collapse = ", "))
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_edges(data = edges, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               color = '#393e46', linewidth = 1) +    
    geom_scatterpie(data = nodes, aes(x = x, y = y, r = 0.007),
                    cols = setdiff(methods, c('MAGMABH', 'cGWAS', 'MAGMABHcGWAS'))) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Methods", values = method_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_label_repel(data = nodes,
                     aes(x = x, y = y, label = name, fill = label_group),
                     size = 3, point.padding = 1, max.time = 5, max.iter = 20000,
                     max.overlaps = 100) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Gene source", values = genesrc_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_blank() +
    guides(color = "none", fill = guide_legend(override.aes = aes(label = "  "))) +
    theme(legend.position = 'left',
          legend.text = element_text(size = 20, vjust = .2),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 22, vjust = 1)) +
    theme_transparent +
    ggtitle(net_name)
}

# One plot per network
consensus_plots <- map2(names(networks), networks, build_consensus_plot)

# Combine into a 2 x 2 figure labelled (a) to (d)
wrap_plots(consensus_plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_layout(guides = 'collect') +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a', tag_prefix = '(', tag_suffix = ')') &
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom')
